annotations.text: Rationale and example sentences become annotations (F2 §4.1), and their quotes were located by the same guard that anchors atoms — which *raises*.
Q-ATOM merged two source sentences into one `rationale` quote, and the exception escaped at node-forming time, **after every model call of the run had been paid for**, losing the whole compile.
An annotation carries no claim, so an unlocatable one is dropped and listed in the run report (`annotations_dropped`), beside D33's empty blocks.
